question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 5.
solution:
The correct answer is **mournfully.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Mournfully** means feeling or expressing sorrow or grief; sorrowful; sad.

 ** • Example- ***The church's funeral bell tolled **mournfully **over the neighbourhood.*

 
• So, it is clear that the most appropriate word is **'mournfully'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Blissfully** means causing complete happiness.
 
• **Gaily** means in a lively manner; cheerfully.
 
• **Chirpily** means in a happy and energetic way.

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 2.**
